role: Directs the campaign: chooses the next category and surface, allocates the budget, halts on spend without signal, and triggers regression runs when the target changes.
trust_level: high: it spends money and chooses what to test, but only within the committed allowlist and the spend ceiling, both of which code enforces

model.proposal: Deterministic code for ranking and budgeting. At most a small, low-cost model to phrase a directive's intent field.
model.reason: Ranking and budget decisions must be explainable and reproducible from the run records alone (SECURITY-PLATFORM.md section 6 Q3). SECURITY-PLATFORM.md's platform architecture leaves 'small/cheap model or deterministic' open.

coordinates_with.red_team: sends attack_directive; never receives a transcript directly
coordinates_with.judge: reads its verdicts from the run records
coordinates_with.documentation: reads open findings and regression cases from the exploit store
